nvitk.stats.violin_hemodynamics¶

Cohort violin + strip hemodynamics plots from qvtpy image_measurements.

Shared by the CLI script scripts/pesa_brain/plotter/violin_hemodynamics.py and the QC GUI cohort-violin dock.

nvitk.stats.violin_hemodynamics.prepare_plot_frame(long_df: pandas.DataFrame, *, variable_id: str, specs: list[tuple[str, str, str]], derive_tcbf: bool) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Filter/reshape long measurements into the violin-plot frame: subject_uid/vessel/group/value.

Optionally derives a synthetic TCBF row per subject, maps region ids to display vessel names and violin groups per specs, and drops zero placeholder values (a project convention for “not measured”).
